name: Fantasista Asuka
storyline:
A chance encounter brings together Daisuke Aozora, a coach with ambitions to train a Japanese women's soccer team that can compete on the world stage, and Asuka Tenma, a player from the bottom-ranked soccer club, the Golden Balls.

Seeing potential in Asuka, Daisuke decides to coach for the Golden Balls.

"I'll guide you from the weakest to the strongest."

From that one chance encounter... From that one promise...

Asuka and her teammates' fates begin to change.

The bottom-rank team's miracle run...!

Strap in for a soccer underdog epic filled with passion and perseverance!
summary: In this real-time soccer sim, play as the coach of a women's soccer team to guide your players to victory! Unlock new players and power up your team as you go through each match. Make your ideal team and go for the gold!!!
